title: Canonical pro-etale scalar/pullback comparison in module-coefficient universes
statement:
Let $u$ be a universe, let $A,B$ be commutative rings of type universe $u+1$, let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital ring homomorphism, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes of universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use the constant coefficient ring sheaves $A_T,B_T$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], their categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and their ordinary unbounded uncompleted derived categories $D(T,A),D(T,B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $S_T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ for the canonical derived scalar extension with its adjunction to exact restriction of scalars $\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi,T}$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and $f_A^*,f_B^*$ for exact derived geometric pullback with the canonical constant-section coefficient identifications [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define
$$\lambda_{\varphi,f}:f_B^*S_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}S_Xf_A^*$$
to be the inverse of the inverse scalar-adjunction mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of the canonical exact restriction/pullback square
$$f_A^*\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi,Y}\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi,X}f_B^*.$$
Here the reverse mate $S_Xf_A^*\to f_B^*S_Y$ is invertible by [lem-sfb-proetale-scalar-pullback-mate-invertible], so its inverse is uniquely determined. This is the canonical derived tensor-balancing comparison, not an arbitrary natural isomorphism. No finiteness, flatness, boundedness, constructibility, or normalization assumption is imposed.

def scalarPullbackProEtaleIso
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (a : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    pbcFixedScalarExtension (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) a ⋙
        L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f) ≅
      L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) ⋙
        pbcFixedScalarExtension (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) a
